actionAdapters.when: 通过describe、plan、execute、verify完成install-latest或upgrade-latest；执行仍绑定当前一次性计划与有效授权，任务必要安装可由NA-014长期授权覆盖，不逐包重复询问
需要按确认计划卸载当前 direct dependency 并核验 Resolve 结果时

inputs.name: packageName
inputs.constraint: Agent可按当前Nova项目任务从PlugPals已配置仓库主动选定所需包和必要依赖；核对用途、当前安装状态、兼容来源/版本与平台，不要求用户先报包名；仅本Skill支持的install-latest受NA-014长期安装授权覆盖

inputs.name: confirmedPlanId
inputs.constraint: 执行使用当前精确PlanId作为token；有效长期安装授权与一次性计划绑定分别核对，不把重新Plan误作必须重新请求同范围授权

allow: Packages/manifest.json direct dependency and scoped registry changes described by the confirmed plan
Packages/packages-lock.json updates produced only by Unity Package Manager Resolve
Library/Nova/ImportantUpdates/<local-user-hash>/State.json automatic upgrade-scope bookkeeping and explicit human acknowledgement; never edited directly by the Agent
deny: com.solotopia.nova.framework self install, upgrade or uninstall
fixed historical version, downgrade, arbitrary registry, git/file/registry source switch or batch upgrade
manual packages-lock edits, cache deletion or automatic replay after failure
SDK or Kit enablement, ConfigMaster, Samples, business source, Bundle, Player, UPM publish or Git operations
automatic Important acknowledgement, UI confirmation simulation, reflection or direct edits to local acknowledgement markers

requiredFor: every install-latest, upgrade-latest or uninstall-direct execution must bind the current exact plan and a valid authorization source
the exact action, packageName, currentVersion, targetVersion and selected configured registry
the exact manifest and scoped registry diff
delete, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: Plan只读；授权依据与一次性计划绑定分别核对。NA-014长期安装授权覆盖的任务必要install-latest，在说明选型及精确计划后可继续执行，不重复请求逐包批准。升级/卸载等动作仍需其适用授权。manifest、lock、远端版本、registry或Editor domain漂移使旧Plan/token失效，必须重新计划并核对原授权是否仍覆盖；不自动重放、不关闭确认门。多个必要包逐包Resolve/Verify后再计划下一包。

evidence: 只读 Plan 中冻结的动作、包名、当前版本、目标版本、registry、依赖和消费者
本次有效授权依据（NA-014长期必要安装授权或其它精确用户授权），以及当前一次性PlanId/token的匹配；不能把机器token当作人类授权
Execute 返回的 partial receipt，且没有自动重放
Unity 稳定后 manifest 与 packages-lock 的精确版本和 registry 来源，或卸载后的双重消失证据
未执行 SDK/Kit 启用、Sample、业务改动、构建、发布或 Git 操作的边界说明
升级后的 CHANGELOG Important 按包分组、包内按完整 SemVer 从新到旧展示，需用户亲自阅读确认；Agent 不得自动确认或改写本地标记；安装成功与人工阅读状态分别报告。
按任务选择必要PlugPals包的用途/兼容来源/版本/平台及依赖依据；已有足够能力不重复安装，多个必要包串行验收，正常传递依赖不无故提升为direct dependency
